assets.prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural
Asset type: physically based game material base-color texture, Korean apartment corridor granite floor.
Input image: the supplied photograph is a material reference from a Korean stone supplier, showing Pocheon granite; use its mineral structure and restrained neutral color, not its exact pixel pattern.
Generate a new square 2048-pixel seamless, edge-to-edge, orthographic albedo texture representing a 60 cm by 60 cm section of lightly polished pale grey Pocheon granite. Fine interlocking quartz and feldspar grains and sparse charcoal mica grains, mostly 1–5 mm, with irregular mineral boundaries. The stone is continuous and planed flat. Subtle local variation, neutral natural pale grey, no yellow or green cast. Diffuse cross-polarized even lighting, no baked illumination, no shading gradients, no highlights, no ambient occlusion. Keep physical material density consistent everywhere. No grout, no tile borders, no seams, no layout panels, no text, no chips protruding above the surface, no terrazzo confetti, no cracks, no mottled cloudy islands. All four edges must tile seamlessly. This is the final usable texture itself, not an illustration of a floor or a material preview sphere.

Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: seamless game PBR base-color texture. From the attached actual Korean CU convenience store interior photograph, study ONLY the pale warm-grey fine-speckled porcelain floor tiles at the bottom left. Generate a new square seamless edge-to-edge orthographic diffuse albedo scan of a single 60 cm x 60 cm unglazed polished porcelain tile surface. Barely visible very fine aggregate, restrained warm grey/off-white, uniform practical commercial flooring, no marble veins, no granite fragments, no dirt stains or damage. Material flatness: perfectly planed ceramic, not bumpy concrete. Cross-polarized neutral white diffuse lighting, no reflections or highlights, no shadows, no gradients. No tile edges, no grout lines, no borders, no text, no logos, no store objects. All four edges seamlessly tile. Final usable material texture, not a scene or a preview sphere. 2048 square.

assets.usage: 정면·측면·윗면을 대조해 SM_HouseSlipper를 모델링했다. 참조 시트는 게임 화면에 쓰지 않는다.
assets.prompt: Use case: product-mockup. Make a precise photorealistic modeling reference sheet of a single unbranded charcoal grey cotton terry indoor open-toe slipper, faithfully based on the supplied real product photograph. Four separate views on one neutral light-grey sheet: top orthographic, outer-side orthographic, front orthographic looking through the open toe, and a clear three-quarter elevated view. Every view depicts the same single slipper with identical construction, simple 27 cm long and 10 cm wide low padded sole, rounded heel, wider rounded toe, a 10 cm long gently arched fabric upper across the front half, and a narrow fabric piping seam around the footbed. No invented straps or buckles, no branding, no text, no ornamental shapes, no feet. Upper reaches about 6 cm above the footbed. Sole thickness around 1.3 cm. Show the open toe and the empty hollow underneath the arch clearly. Uniform neutral studio light with soft contact shadow; realistic restrained fabric nap, no excessive shaggy fuzz. Include a small additional macro inset of the grey terry fabric and the seam to guide a PBR material. This is a functional everyday home object, not fantasy footwear.

usage: 원본은 변경 없이 보존. 엔진에서 1K 밉 체인으로 가져오며 월드 좌표 60cm마다 반복한다. 색상의 명암을 높이로 해석하지 않는다. 줄눈과 거칠기는 재질에서 따로 지정한다.
